slots.name: duration of intense munition use
slots.sentence: This was particularly evident through the first six weeks of the conflict, when the use of munitions was intense.

slots.name: US hardware diverted from Indo-Pacific
slots.sentence: The diversion of American hardware away from the Indo-Pacific, including a carrier strike group and a battery of THAAD interceptors with associated radar, has some analysts worried.

slots.name: U.S. munitions stockpile status
slots.sentence: The Iran war has significantly strained U.S. munitions stockpiles, with replenishment expected to take several years.

slots.name: China's missile inventory
slots.sentence: Wargames further suggest that China’s inventories of thousands of offensive cruise and ballistic missiles, to say nothing of its drones, could exhaust existing magazine depth within weeks in the event of high-end conflict, especially over Taiwan.

slots.name: impact on global economic output
slots.sentence: It has shaved an estimated hundreds of billions of dollars from projected global output.

slots.name: U.S. financial cost
slots.sentence: The war has already cost the U.S. tens of billions of dollars and caused thousands in Iranian casualties.

slots.name: impact on global oil company profits
slots.sentence: The war in Iran has helped drive profits for global oil giants to their highest level in years.

slots.name: U.S. casualties
slots.unit: U.S. service personnel killed; over 400 injured
slots.sentence: Meanwhile, Iran has also fired thousands of missiles and drones at land targets in the region, hitting U.S. bases and tragically killing seven U.S. service personnel while injuring over 400 .

slots.name: aircraft damaged
slots.sentence: Iran also damaged dozens of U.S. aircraft, including critical airborne warning and control aircraft and aerial refueling aircraft.
